# Fixtures

`state/` is a cc-desk state folder; each test copies it into a temporary folder. Its `alpha` release is the worked case for passes 2 to 4: twelve finished passes at the clock 2026-11-20T23:00:00Z (2:00 pm Alaska time), a pace of 1.2 with a range of 0.8 to 1.5 from the last ten. `state/snapshot.json` is what the snapshot verb prints for it at that clock, and a test fails when it falls behind.

Its `beta` release has two finished passes (planned 40 and 50, taking 45 and 55), so its estimate is rough: pace 1.0 and no range. Round `b3` needs Geoff and has no design, and its predecessor pass `b-three` is planned at 480 minutes, so at the 2:00 pm clock `b3` starts at 10:00 pm, after alpha's 9:30 pm range end. Tests that need a written question for beta record `inputs/design-b3.json`.

`order/` is a second state folder for the start rules and the waiting order. It has two releases, `north` and `south`, each with one designed round that needs Geoff, and no `usage.json` or `settings.json`, so the usage stop is 100 and the first verb takes a reading. Every question is unanswered, with the options `yes` and `no` and `yes` recommended. `north` has `n-free` (60 minutes), `n-two` (30), `n-big` (400, rests on `north-q1`), `n-guess` (200, rests on `north-q2`), and `n-after` (50, after `n-guess`). `south` has `s-free` (45), `s-two` (30), and `s-guess` (150, rests on `south-q1`).

`writers/` is a third state folder, for twenty verbs at once. Its releases `east` and `west` each have one designed round that needs nothing from Geoff, seven building passes (`e-1` to `e-7`, `w-1` to `w-7`), and three unanswered questions that no pass rests on (`east-q1` to `east-q3`, `west-q1` to `west-q3`). It has no `usage.json`, so every verb takes a reading.

`usage40.sh` stands in for `claude -p "/usage"` and prints a 40 percent result. Every e2e run passes it as `--usage-command` and runs the binary with a `PATH` of `/usr/bin:/bin`, so no test reaches the real `claude`.

`check-merge/gh.py` stands in for the `gh` the check runs. The merge tests copy it into their rig folder, pass it as `--gh-command`, and give it one answer file per branch for `pr list --head <branch>`. Its `pr merge` call merges the branch into `main` on the rig's bare remote with a real `git merge --no-ff`, and it refuses when `--match-head-commit` is not the answer's head. A `down` file makes every call exit 1. The merge tests write the release's passes as building directly, because `pass start` holds a third building pass back, and they set every session row to done so the row rules leave a waiting pass alone.

`real-2026-11-18/` is a copy of the real state folder `~/.local/state/cc-desk`, taken on 2026-11-18 under a shared lock on its `lock` file, with the lock files left out. It holds one release, `cc-desk-scratch`, with a finished round `live` of two merged passes, and two launch settings files. Nothing in it is edited. `TestRealCopy` reads it, rewrites its release with one verb, and checks that every key path survived. It proves a folder written before the records of the desk round still reads.

`desk/` is a fourth state folder for the records of the desk round, with no `usage.json`. Its release `alpha` has one designed round `r1` and a free pass `a-free` (10 minutes) resting on the question `qa`, which carries a background, causes for both options, and a reason. Its release `beta` has one designed round `b1` with a building pass `b-build` (20 minutes, started at 22:30Z), then `b-after` (30 minutes, after `b-build`) resting on the never-guessed question `qb`, then `b-tail` (40 minutes, after `b-after`). `inputs/question-q9.json` is a whole question for `question add alpha r2`, naming pass `p14` of the `state` fixture.

The `desk/` fixture also holds the needs-you-now cases of the desk round. `alpha` has a conductor that ended on an expired sign-in (`sign_in_expired`, ended 22:05Z) with one refusal, and a stopped pass `a-stopped` (15 minutes, scope stop at 22:40Z, `no_need_reason` "It only renames files."). `beta` round `b1` has a design writer that ended on a failed launch (`launch_failed`). At the worked clock only the stopped pass and the failed launch need Geoff.

The `desk/` fixture also carries `check-log.jsonl`: four lines, a conductor launch and its sign-in stop for `alpha`, then a relaunch for `beta` that worked and one that was not relaunched, so a brief can tell a restart from a refusal.

The `desk/` fixture also holds the brief's cases. `desks.json` records one desk that started at 21:30Z, so the brief's log section shows the three check-log lines after it and leaves out the 21:00Z launch. `beta` has a second round `b2` with a building pass `b4` (60 minutes) whose ready pull request 12 at commit `3f2a9c1` carries the merge question `merge-b4-1`. At the worked clock the forecast puts `qa` first (it is needed now) and the brief puts `qb` first (70 minutes held up), then the merge question (60), then `qa` (10).
